title: AuditRecord
description: The persisted unit of audit history: a normalized event wrapped with a deterministic record id, recording time, data classification, redaction table, optional correction links, and the integrity digest slot. Records are append-only; nothing in this schema mutates.

record_id.description: Deterministically derived from the canonical bytes of the embedded event.

recorded_at.description: UTC Unix seconds; when the record was created, never part of its identity.

classification.description: The most sensitive classification held by this record's content.

redactions.description: Field-level classification table used for redaction and export.

supersedes.description: Present only on record-corrected records; names the original, which is never mutated.
